sections.overall: As AEW has been in such strong form this year, it's telling when a great PPV "feels" average. WrestleDream '26 had plenty of highlights, including the best match of the week, The Young Bucks vs Fletcher & Knight (9.08), which exceeded even its lofty expectations! Neither the Dynamite nor the Collision go-home show was especially memorable, but it was still another excellent week overall!
sections.mens: Surprisingly, the inaugural Clockwork Carnage match, featuring eight of AEW's best, was NOT the Men's highlight of the night, or of the week. That honour instead goes to Jon Moxley vs Mark Davis (8.75), a bloody, grisly affair that boosted both men's ratings. Davis enters the "Silver" tier for the first time! Another highlight of the week was the qualifying match between Darby Allin and Hechicero (7.81).
sections.womens: Ultimately, the first singles match between Mercedes Mone and Thekla was a slight disappointment (7.51), with no major shifts for either woman. Here's hoping a rematch is on the cards, especially given Thekla's potential as a face. The TBS four-way suffered from a lack of build and no time to develop any feuds. AEW need to book the women's midcard better, given the incredible roster they have.
sections.menstag: Aside from the Tag Title match, the first match of the Best of 5 Series between The Motor City Machine Guns and FTR was a decent bout (7.69). It counts as an eligible match because, although it started on the Pre-Show, it spilled over onto the main card, so Cagematch officially records it there.
sections.womenstag: Due to Jamie Hayter's unfortunate injury, the title match has been delayed, hopefully not for long. Divine Dominion and Sisters Of Sin both featured as teams within their Trios match on Dynamite. Tag teams in a Trios match gain or lose less than in a straight tag match, as more competitors are involved.
sections.trios: Another excellent match between The New Level & Strickland and the new champs, Brodido & Page (8.3). Although it was rated lower than their All Out classic, both teams are now well into the 130s, the strongest any Trios teams have been in AEW since 2023!
